repos.description: A list of Free Software network services and web applications which can be hosted on your own servers
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个全面的自托管开源软件目录，涵盖通信、存储、管理、媒体等数十个类别，提供替代SaaS的私有化部署方案。核心价值在于帮助用户实现数据主权、隐私保护和基础设施自主可控。项目持续维护，包含死链检查和活跃度监控，是自建服务器的终极参考指南。
repos.summary_en: A comprehensive directory of self-hostable open-source network services and web applications spanning communications, storage, management, media, and dozens of categories. It enables private deployment alternatives to SaaS, empowering data sovereignty, privacy protection, and infrastructure autonomy. Continuously maintained with automated dead link validation and project health monitoring, it serves as the definitive reference for building and maintaining a self-hosted server ecosystem.

repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.summary_zh: Open WebUI是功能完备的自托管AI平台，无缝集成Ollama与OpenAI API，支持完全离线部署。内置RAG推理引擎和原生Python函数调用工具，提供细粒度用户权限管理、响应式界面及PWA移动应用。支持语音/视频通话、Markdown/LaTeX渲染，可通过插件系统扩展功能。提供Docker/Kubernetes部署方案，适用于企业级AI应用开发与私有化大模型部署场景。
repos.summary_en: Open WebUI is a comprehensive self-hosted AI platform that seamlessly integrates Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs with full offline deployment capability. Featuring a built-in RAG inference engine and native Python function calling tools, it offers granular user permissions, responsive design, and PWA mobile support. The platform enables voice/video calls, Markdown/LaTeX rendering, and extensible plugin architecture. Deployable via Docker/Kubernetes, it serves as an enterprise-grade solution for private LLM orchestration and AI application development requiring air-gapped security.

repos.description: A list of SaaS, PaaS and IaaS offerings that have free tiers of interest to devops and infradev
repos.summary_zh: free-for-dev 是专为 DevOps 和基础设施开发者打造的免费服务精选清单，聚合主流云厂商、CI/CD、监控、数据库等20+类别 SaaS/PaaS/IaaS 永久免费层。由1600+社区贡献者维护，提供可立即使用的技术栈参考，规避免费试用陷阱，助力开发者快速构建和运维低成本技术架构。
repos.summary_en: free-for-dev is a curated list of free-tier SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS offerings specifically for DevOps and infrastructure developers. It aggregates permanently free services across 20+ categories including major cloud providers, CI/CD, monitoring, databases, and generative AI. Maintained by 1,600+ contributors, it provides immediate technical stack references, helps avoid free-trial traps, and enables building cost-effective architectures with confidence.

repos.description: Official Crawl4AI Cloud: a hosted web scraping, extraction, and search API for AI agents. Free API key, 1,000 credits a month, no card. Fully open source: this repo is the Apache-2.0 crawler that powers it, and you can self-host it.
repos.summary_zh: Crawl4AI 是一款开源的LLM友好型网页爬虫，专为RAG、AI代理和数据管道设计。它将网页转换为干净的Markdown格式，便于大语言模型处理。项目亮点包括：崩溃恢复机制支持长时间深度爬取；预取模式提升5-10倍URL发现速度；提供自托管平台，含企业级监控仪表板和REST API；采用浏览器池管理技术。拥有5万+星标社区验证，相比现有方案显著降低成本，支持完全本地化部署。
repos.summary_en: Crawl4AI is an open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler designed for RAG, AI agents, and data pipelines. It converts web content into clean Markdown format optimized for language models. Key features include crash recovery for long-running deep crawls, prefetch mode for 5-10x faster URL discovery, and a self-hosting platform with enterprise-grade monitoring dashboard, REST API, and WebSocket streaming. Battle-tested by a 50k+ star community, it offers a cost-effective alternative to paid solutions with full local deployment capabilities and smart browser pool management.

repos.description: Course to get into Large Language Models (LLMs) with roadmaps and Colab notebooks.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个免费的LLM系统学习课程，提供从数学基础到工程实践的完整路线图。课程分为三部分：LLM基础、LLM科学家（模型构建与优化）和LLM工程师（应用开发与部署）。包含大量实用的Google Colab notebooks，涵盖模型微调、合并、量化、评估等实战技术，并配套自动化工具，适合想深入LLM领域的开发者。
repos.summary_en: This is a free, comprehensive LLM course offering structured learning paths from mathematical foundations to production deployment. The curriculum is divided into three parts: LLM Fundamentals, The LLM Scientist (focusing on building optimal models with cutting-edge techniques), and The LLM Engineer (covering application development and deployment). It provides extensive Google Colab notebooks for hands-on practice, including tools for fine-tuning, model merging, quantization, and automated evaluation. Based on the LLM Engineer's Handbook, it's designed for developers seeking practical LLM expertise.

repos.description: 《动手学大模型Dive into LLMs》系列编程实践教程
repos.summary_zh: 本教程源自上海交大课程，提供大模型全栈实践指南。涵盖微调部署、提示工程、知识编辑、数学推理、模型水印、越狱攻击等前沿主题。每个章节配套Jupyter Notebook脚本与课件，支持华为昇腾国产化平台。适合高校教学、学术研究与工业实践，助力快速掌握大模型开发与安全攻防技术。
repos.summary_en: This hands-on tutorial series, derived from Shanghai Jiao Tong University courses, offers comprehensive LLMs practical guidance. Covering fine-tuning, prompting, knowledge editing, math reasoning, model watermarking, and jailbreak attacks. Each chapter includes Jupyter notebooks and slides, supporting Huawei Ascend platform. Ideal for academic teaching, research, and industrial practice in LLM development and security.

repos.description: Windows inside a Docker container.
repos.summary_zh: dockur/windows 仓库提供 Docker 镜像，在容器内运行完整 Windows 操作系统。集成 ISO 自动下载、KVM 硬件加速和 Web 远程查看器，支持 Win11/10/服务器等多版本。通过 Docker Compose、CLI 或 Kubernetes 快速部署，适用于开发测试、遗留软件兼容、云原生 Windows 应用托管等场景。亮点包括全自动安装流程、硬件加速及多平台集成，极大简化 Windows 虚拟化部署。
repos.summary_en: The dockur/windows repository delivers a Docker image for running full Windows operating systems inside containers. It features automatic ISO downloading, KVM hardware acceleration, and a web-based viewer. Supporting Windows 11, 10, servers, and older versions, it enables quick deployment via Docker Compose, CLI, or Kubernetes. Ideal for development/testing, legacy software support, and containerized Windows apps in cloud or Linux environments. Highlights include fully automated setup, performance acceleration, and broad DevOps integration.

repos.description: Open-source AI gateway. Self-hosted LLM gateway with OpenAI-, Claude- and Gemini-compatible APIs, model routing, access control, usage tracking and cost accounting.
repos.summary_zh: New API 是一款下一代 LLM 网关与 AI 资产管理系统，通过协议转换层将各类大模型统一为 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini 兼容接口。提供集中式模型路由、分发与管理能力，支持个人与企业级部署，构建跨模型生态的标准化接入平面。
repos.summary_en: New API is a next-generation LLM gateway and AI asset management system that unifies diverse large language models through protocol conversion layers into OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini-compatible interfaces. It provides centralized model routing, load balancing, and distribution management for both personal and enterprise deployments. Built with Go for high performance, the system acts as a standardized access plane for cross-model ecosystems, enabling seamless integration, governance, and observability of heterogeneous AI assets while maintaining strict API compatibility and enterprise-grade security.

repos.description: Your lightweight open-source personal agent.
repos.summary_zh: nanobot 是 HKUDS 开发的开源超轻量级 AI 智能体，核心设计精简且可读。它支持聊天通道、记忆管理和 MCP 协议，可无缝集成工具与工作流。内置 WebUI，提供跨轮次目标追踪和图像生成能力，支持多模型 fallback。从本地快速部署到长期运行的个性化智能体，适用于自动化任务和智能助手场景。
repos.summary_en: nanobot is an open-source, ultra-lightweight AI agent developed by HKUDS, featuring a minimalist and readable core design. It supports chat channels, memory management, and the MCP protocol for seamless tool and workflow integration. With a built-in WebUI, it offers cross-turn goal tracking and end-to-end image generation, along with multi-model fallback support. Designed for easy deployment from local setups to long-running personal agents, it is ideal for automation tasks and intelligent assistant applications.

repos.description: Official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs
repos.summary_zh: 微软官方1-bit大模型推理框架，专为1.58-bit三元模型优化。基于llama.cpp构建，提供CPU/GPU无损快速推理，性能提升最高6.17倍，能耗降低82%。支持单CPU运行100B参数模型，速度达5-7 token/秒。采用查找表与并行内核技术，实现边缘设备高效部署，推动大模型本地化应用。
repos.summary_en: Microsoft's official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs, optimized for 1.58-bit ternary models. Built on llama.cpp, it delivers lossless fast inference on CPU/GPU with up to 6.17x speedup and 82% energy reduction. Enables running 100B-parameter models on a single CPU at human reading speed (5-7 tokens/sec). Features optimized kernels using lookup table methodologies and parallel implementations with configurable tiling and embedding quantization. Empowers efficient edge deployment of large models, advancing local AI applications.

repos.description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.
repos.summary_zh: QwenPaw是自主可控的个人AI助手，支持本地或云端部署确保数据隐私。提供日程管理、PDF/Office文档处理、新闻摘要等内置技能，支持自定义扩展。具备多智能体协作能力，可创建独立代理处理不同任务。跨平台连接多种聊天应用，技能决定功能边界，无供应商锁定风险。
repos.summary_en: QwenPaw is a personal AI assistant under your control, deployable locally or in the cloud to ensure data privacy. It features built-in skills including scheduling, PDF/Office document processing, and news digests, with support for custom extensions. Enables multi-agent collaboration by creating independent agents for different tasks. Connects across multiple chat platforms with extensible capabilities and no vendor lock-in.

repos.description: An evolving how-to guide for securing a Linux server.
repos.summary_zh: 这个仓库提供全面的 Linux 服务器安全加固实践指南，涵盖 SSH 密钥与 2FA 认证、UFW 防火墙配置、Fail2Ban/CrowdSec 入侵防御、AIDE 文件完整性监控等核心模块。通过 Ansible Playbooks 实现自动化部署，结合纵深防御理念，为系统管理员和 DevOps 提供从基础加固到持续审计的一站式安全解决方案。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a comprehensive, continuously updated guide for Linux server security hardening with actionable implementations. It systematically covers SSH hardening with key-based authentication and two-factor authentication, network security via UFW firewall and PSAD intrusion detection, application-layer protection using Fail2Ban and CrowdSec, and continuous monitoring through AIDE file integrity checks, Lynis auditing, and OSSEC HIDS. The guide emphasizes defense-in-depth strategies and provides production-ready Ansible Playbooks for automated deployment, making it an essential resource for system administrators, DevOps engineers, and security professionals seeking to implement robust server security from fundamentals to advanced threat detection.

repos.description: A self-hostable bookmark-everything app (links, notes and images) with AI-based automatic tagging and full text search
repos.summary_zh: Karakeep 是一款自托管的书签管理工具，支持链接、笔记、图片和 PDF 的收藏。核心亮点包括 AI 自动标签与摘要（支持 ChatGPT 和本地 Ollama 模型）、全文搜索、OCR 文字识别，以及完整的网页与视频归档功能。提供浏览器插件、iOS/Android 应用，并可通过 RSS 自动抓取。基于 NextJS 和 tRPC 构建，注重隐私与数据自主，适合数字资料囤积者。
repos.summary_en: Karakeep is a self-hostable bookmark manager designed for digital hoarders to collect links, notes, images, and PDFs. It leverages AI for automatic tagging and summarization, supporting both ChatGPT and local Ollama models. The app provides full-text search, OCR for image text extraction, and complete web/video archiving using monolith and yt-dlp. Available on web, mobile (iOS/Android), and browsers via extensions, it includes RSS auto-hoarding, REST API, and SSO. Built with NextJS, Drizzle ORM, and tRPC, it emphasizes privacy and data sovereignty.

repos.description: 最好用的 V2Ray 一键安装脚本 & 管理脚本
repos.summary_zh: 233boy/v2ray 是一款专注于 V2Ray 自动化部署与管理的 Shell 脚本工具。通过极简命令行交互，实现一键安装、配置管理与协议切换，大幅降低 V2Ray 使用门槛。核心亮点包括多协议支持（VMess/VLESS/Trojan/Shadowsocks）、自动化 TLS 证书申请、多配置并行运行及动态端口管理。适用于快速搭建科学上网代理服务器，满足隐私保护与网络访问需求。
repos.summary_en: 233boy/v2ray is a Shell script tool focused on automated deployment and management of V2Ray. It simplifies complex configurations through minimal command-line interactions, enabling one-click installation, configuration management, and protocol switching. Key features include multi-protocol support (VMess/VLESS/Trojan/Shadowsocks), automated TLS certificate provisioning, concurrent multi-configuration operation, and dynamic port management. Ideal for rapidly deploying scientific上网 proxy servers for privacy protection and network access needs.

repos.description: 🗃 Open source self-hosted web archiving. Takes URLs/browser history/bookmarks/Pocket/Pinboard/etc., saves HTML, JS, PDFs, media, and more...
repos.summary_zh: ArchiveBox 是一款开源自托管网页存档工具，支持从浏览器书签、历史记录、Pocket、Pinboard 等多源导入 URL，完整保存 HTML、JS、PDF、媒体文件等内容。采用标准化格式（WARC、SQLite、JSON）确保数据长期可读，提供 CLI、REST API 和 Webhook 集成能力。适用于个人知识管理、企业证据保全及数字资产备份，支持 Docker 快速部署。
repos.summary_en: ArchiveBox is an open-source self-hosted web archiving solution that preserves web content from URLs, browser history, bookmarks, Pocket, Pinboard, and more. It captures comprehensive snapshots including HTML, JavaScript, PDFs, and media files in standardized formats (WARC, SQLite, JSON) ensuring long-term accessibility. The tool offers CLI, REST API, and webhook integrations for automation, with Docker support for easy deployment. Ideal for personal knowledge management, legal evidence preservation, and social media backup, it gives users full control over their archived data.

repos.description: Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs
repos.summary_zh: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源平价替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、反向链接、站点审计及 AI 可见性等核心 SEO 工作流。通过 MCP 服务器和可复用技能实现与 Claude 等 AI 智能体的深度集成，支持 Docker 或 Cloudflare 自托管，用户自带 DataForSEO API 密钥实现按需付费。界面简洁现代，聚焦高效工作流，适合个人、团队及 AI 驱动的 SEO 策略定制与控制。
repos.summary_en: OpenSEO is an open-source, pay-as-you-go alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, delivering essential SEO workflows including keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlinks, site audits, and AI visibility. It features deep AI agent integration via MCP server and customizable skills for tools like Claude, with self-hosting options (Docker or Cloudflare) and BYO DataForSEO API key for usage-based costs. The modern, focused UI empowers individuals, teams, and AI-powered SEO strategies with full control and customization.

repos.description: Huly — All-in-One Project Management Platform (alternative to Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Motion)
repos.summary_zh: Huly Platform 是开源一体化项目管理平台，替代 Jira、Linear 等工具。提供 Chat、CRM、HRM、ATS 等模块化应用，支持自托管与 API 驱动开发。基于 Node.js 全栈框架，采用 Docker 容器化部署，加速企业级业务应用构建，实现多团队协作与流程自动化。
repos.summary_en: Huly Platform is an open-source all-in-one project management solution that replaces Jira, Linear, Slack, and Notion. It provides modular applications including Chat, CRM, HRM, and ATS with self-hosting capability. Built on a Node.js full-stack framework using Docker containerization, it accelerates enterprise business application development through API-driven integration and automated workflows for team collaboration.

repos.description: Lightweight server monitoring with historical data, docker stats, and alerts.
repos.summary_zh: Beszel 是一款基于 PocketBase 的轻量级服务器监控平台，采用 hub-agent 架构。它提供 Docker 容器资源统计、历史数据追踪和自定义告警功能，支持多用户管理、OAuth 认证与自动备份。相比主流方案资源占用更低，具备友好 Web 界面，开箱即用，适合个人及小型团队监控物理服务器、虚拟机和容器化环境。
repos.summary_en: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform built on PocketBase using a hub-agent architecture. It tracks Docker container metrics, historical data, and configurable alerts while supporting multi-user management, OAuth authentication, and automatic backups. With significantly lower resource consumption than leading solutions and an intuitive web interface, it's ideal for individuals and small teams monitoring physical servers, VMs, and containerized environments.

repos.description: 🥢像老乡鸡🐔那样做饭。已添加2026年发布的《老乡鸡菜品溯源报告 2.0中新出现的菜品。主要部分于2024年完工，非老乡鸡官方仓库。文字来自《老乡鸡菜品溯源报告》，并做归纳、编辑与整理。CookLikeHOC.
repos.summary_zh: 将老乡鸡标准化菜谱开源化，基于《老乡鸡菜品溯源报告》整理，提供可复制的家庭烹饪指南。技术亮点包括Docker容器化部署、AI手绘图解流程、网页端交互界面。核心价值在于中餐标准化与规模化烹饪方案的平民化，适合家庭烹饪爱好者与餐饮技术研究者。
repos.summary_en: This repository open-sources standardized recipes from Laoxiangji, compiled from their traceability reports to provide replicable home cooking guides. Technical highlights include Docker containerization, AI-generated hand-drawn illustrations, and a web interface. It democratizes Chinese restaurant-standardized cooking methods for home cooks and culinary tech enthusiasts.

repos.description: Open-source gym & body-weight tracker, now in the App Store (iPhone + Apple Watch) and as an Android APK. Plan routines, log workouts, see which muscles are trained, import from Strong/Hevy/FitNotes. Self-host it or use it on the phone alone.
repos.summary_zh: openGym 是一款自托管健身与体重追踪应用，支持训练计划、组数记录、肌肉疲劳分析、跨设备同步与 Passkey 登录。数据完全由用户掌控，支持从 FitNotes/Strong/Hevy 导入，提供 Android APK 与 Web 端，是隐私优先的开源健身管理方案。
repos.summary_en: openGym is a self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker that lets you plan weekly routines, log every set including supersets, warm-ups, and cardio, and visualize which muscles are trained, fatigued, or detrained. It supports cross-device sync, passkey login, and data import from FitNotes, Strong, and Hevy. Your data stays on your own server, giving you full ownership and privacy. Available as a web app and Android APK, it's a privacy-first, open-source alternative to commercial fitness subscriptions, with stats dashboards featuring heatmaps, charts, and personal records.

repos.description: A self hosted virtual browser that runs in docker and uses WebRTC.
repos.summary_zh: Neko 是一款基于 Docker 的自托管虚拟浏览器，通过 WebRTC 实现低延迟桌面流传输。它提供安全隔离的浏览器环境，支持多用户同时访问，适用于隐私保护、团队协作和社交娱乐（如在线观影派对）。项目解决了传统共享方式（如 Discord）的崩溃问题，为远程互动提供稳定解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Neko is a self-hosted virtual browser running in Docker, streaming desktop via WebRTC. It offers a secure, isolated browsing environment with multi-user access, ideal for privacy protection, team collaboration, and social entertainment (e.g., watch parties). Designed to overcome instability of traditional sharing tools like Discord, it provides a stable, low-latency solution for remote interaction.

repos.description: A full-featured, hackable Next.js AI chatbot built by Vercel
repos.summary_zh: Vercel开源的全功能AI聊天机器人模板，基于Next.js 14 App Router与React Server Components构建。集成Vercel AI SDK提供统一LLM API，默认支持xAI，可无缝切换OpenAI等提供商。采用shadcn/ui组件与Tailwind CSS样式，数据持久化依托Neon Serverless Postgres和Vercel Blob存储，内置Auth.js认证。支持一键部署至Vercel，为开发者提供开箱即用的可扩展聊天应用解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Vercel's open-source, full-featured AI chatbot template built with Next.js 14 App Router and React Server Components. Powered by Vercel AI SDK for unified LLM API access, defaulting to xAI while supporting seamless integration with OpenAI, Anthropic, and other providers. Features shadcn/ui components styled with Tailwind CSS, data persistence via Neon Serverless Postgres and Vercel Blob storage, and Auth.js authentication. Enables developers to quickly build and deploy hackable chatbot applications with one-click Vercel deployment.

repos.description: SkillOpt is a text-space optimizer that trains reusable natural-language skills for frozen LLM agents through trajectory-driven edits, validation-gated updates, and deployable best_skill.md artifacts.
repos.summary_zh: SkillOpt是微软的文本空间优化器，为冻结LLM代理训练可复用自然语言技能。通过轨迹驱动编辑、验证门控更新，模拟神经网络训练（epochs、mini-batch、学习率），不修改模型权重，输出best_skill.md。支持SearchQA、ALFWorld等多基准，适用于自进化代理技能场景。技术亮点包括轨迹分析、迭代优化与可复用部署。
repos.summary_en: SkillOpt is a Microsoft text-space optimizer that trains reusable natural-language skills for frozen LLM agents. It uses trajectory-driven edits, reflection, bounded updates, and held-out validation gates, mirroring neural network training with epochs, minibatches, learning rates, and gates—but entirely in text space without weight changes. It produces deployable best_skill.md artifacts and shows strong gains across benchmarks like SearchQA, ALFWorld, DocVQA, and others. Ideal for self-evolving, transferable agent skills in QA, tool-use, math, and embodied tasks.

repos.description: Turn any website into a structured API. Extract, automate, search and monitor the web.
repos.summary_zh: Maxun 是一款开源无代码网页数据平台，可将任意网站转化为结构化 API。它提供四大机器人类型：Extract（支持录制和 AI 自然语言提取）、Scrape（整页转 Markdown/HTML）、Crawl（全站爬取）和 Search（自动化搜索）。平台通过模拟真实用户行为，实现从简单到复杂的自动化数据采集，适用于 AI 工作流、竞品监控和商业智能等场景。
repos.summary_en: Maxun is an open-source no-code web data platform that transforms any website into structured APIs. It offers four robot types: Extract (with Recorder and AI natural language modes), Scrape (full-page to Markdown/HTML), Crawl (entire site crawling), and Search (automated web searches). By emulating real user behavior, it enables automated data collection workflows for AI pipelines, competitive intelligence, and business analytics.

repos.description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone)
repos.summary_zh: Sure 是一款开源个人理财与财富管理应用，由社区维护的 Maybe Finance 分支发展而来。支持 Docker 自托管，提供浏览器、macOS 桌面、移动端、API 及 LLM 代理等多种客户端，内置 AI 助手解答财务问题，帮助用户全面掌控现金流、净资产与消费支出。
repos.summary_en: Sure is an open-source personal finance and wealth management app, a community-maintained fork of Maybe Finance. It supports Docker self-hosting and offers multiple clients including browser, macOS desktop, mobile, API, and LLM agents. An AI assistant answers financial questions, helping users track cashflow, net worth, and spending.

repos.description: Self-hosted, plugin-based server management.
repos.summary_zh: Termix是一款开源自托管的Web服务器管理平台，为系统管理员提供一体化运维解决方案。核心功能包括：全功能SSH终端（支持分屏与标签页）、SSH隧道管理（自动重连与健康监测）、远程文件管理（支持代码/媒体编辑与Sudo权限）、Docker容器管控及服务器监控（CPU/内存/磁盘/防火墙）。采用React+Tailwind构建现代化响应式界面，支持RBAC权限体系、OIDC/2FA认证与SQLite数据库加密，是Termius的开源免费替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Termix is an open-source, self-hosted web platform for comprehensive server infrastructure management. It provides a full-featured SSH terminal with split-screen and tab support, automated SSH tunneling with health monitoring, and a remote file manager with sudo privileges. The platform integrates Docker container management, real-time server monitoring (CPU/memory/disk/network/firewall), and RBAC-based team collaboration. Built with React and Tailwind CSS, it features OIDC/2FA authentication, encrypted SQLite storage, and automatic SSL setup, serving as a free, all-in-one alternative to commercial solutions like Termius.

repos.description: 一键DD/重装脚本 (One-click reinstall OS on VPS)
repos.summary_zh: 该脚本为 VPS 提供一键重装解决方案，支持 19 种 Linux 发行版与 Windows 官方原版 ISO 互转。采用分区表 ID 识别硬盘确保操作安全，智能配置动静态网络适配 /32、纯 IPv6 等特殊环境，内存占用低于官方 netboot，兼容 BIOS/EFI 及 ARM 架构，所有资源实时从官方源获取。
repos.summary_en: This script provides a one-click OS reinstall solution for VPS, supporting 19 Linux distributions and Windows official ISO cross-installation between Linux and Windows systems. It uses partition table ID to identify disks ensuring operation safety, intelligently configures static/dynamic networking for special environments like /32, pure IPv6, and IPv4/IPv6 on different NICs. Optimized for low-resource VPS with minimal memory footprint, it supports BIOS/EFI and ARM architectures, sourcing all resources directly from official mirrors in real-time without custom packages.

repos.description: Turn your Notion workspace into a fast, customizable website. Built with Next.js + Notion API, with multi-platform deployment and no self-hosted server required.
repos.summary_zh: NotionNext是基于Next.js与Notion API构建的高颜值静态博客系统，支持Vercel等多种部署方案，实现零服务器成本的网站搭建。专为创作者设计，可将Notion页面无缝转化为博客内容，提供主题定制、SEO优化及自动化部署能力，大幅降低技术门槛。
repos.summary_en: NotionNext is a visually appealing static blog system built with Next.js and Notion API, supporting multiple deployment options like Vercel for zero-server website setup. Designed for creators, it seamlessly transforms Notion pages into blog content with theme customization, SEO optimization, and automated deployment, significantly lowering technical barriers.

repos.description: The open-source, privacy-friendly CAPTCHA you host yourself. Bots and AI agents out, people in.
repos.summary_zh: Cap 是一款隐私优先的自托管验证码替代方案，采用 SHA-256 工作量证明机制，摒弃传统视觉 puzzles。仅 20KB 大小，零依赖，加载毫秒级，支持 Docker 独立部署。提供隐形验证与 M2M API 保护能力，通过 CSS 变量实现深度定制，为现代 Web 应用提供高效、私密的 bot 防护。
repos.summary_en: Cap is a privacy-first, self-hosted CAPTCHA alternative that replaces visual puzzles with SHA-256 proof-of-work challenges. At just 20KB with zero dependencies, it loads in milliseconds and supports standalone Docker deployment. Featuring invisible validation, M2M API protection, and CSS variable customization, it provides efficient, private bot mitigation for modern web applications.

repos.description: nodejs-argo是一个强大的Argo隧道部署工具，专为PaaS平台和游戏玩具平台设计。它支持多种代理协议(VLESS、VMess、Trojan)等，有直连协议(Socks5、Hysteria2、Reality)可选开启，并集成了哪吒探针功能
repos.summary_zh: nodejs-argo是一个专为PaaS平台和游戏玩具平台设计的Argo隧道代理部署工具，支持VLESS、VMess、Trojan等多种协议，并集成哪吒探针功能。基于Node.js实现，支持环境变量配置的固定/临时隧道、订阅生成及自动保活，适用于个人代理节点搭建。核心亮点包括多协议兼容、哪吒监控集成及npm模块化部署。
repos.summary_en: nodejs-argo is a powerful Argo tunnel deployment tool designed for PaaS and game toy platforms. It supports multiple proxy protocols including VLESS, VMess, and Trojan, with integrated Nezha probe functionality. Built on Node.js, it enables easy configuration via environment variables for fixed or temporary tunnels, subscription generation, and auto keep-alive, ideal for personal proxy node setup on cloud platforms. Key highlights include multi-protocol support, Nezha monitoring, and npm package deployment.

repos.description: AI 视频笔记生成工具 让 AI 为你的视频做笔记
repos.summary_zh: BiliNote 是一款开源的 AI 视频笔记生成工具，支持 B 站、YouTube、抖音等多平台视频。通过 Fast-Whisper 实现本地音频转写，结合 GPT 大模型（OpenAI/DeepSeek/Qwen）自动生成结构化 Markdown 笔记。支持自动截图、视频跳转、多风格摘要，可本地部署保障隐私，适合学习、知识管理与内容创作场景。
repos.summary_en: BiliNote is an open-source AI-powered video note-taking tool supporting Bilibili, YouTube, Douyin and more. It leverages Fast-Whisper for local audio transcription and GPT models (OpenAI/DeepSeek/Qwen) to automatically generate structured Markdown notes. Features include auto-screenshots, video timestamp links, customizable summary styles, and local deployment for privacy protection. Ideal for learning, knowledge management, and content creation workflows with GPU acceleration support.

repos.description: Email for professionals and teams
repos.summary_zh: Mailflare 是基于 Cloudflare 的自托管专业邮件收件箱，支持自定义域名。通过 Cloudflare Email Routing 与 Workers 实现收发邮件、附件、共享邮箱、路由规则、实时通知等完整功能。数据存于用户自有 D1 与 R2，可一键部署或 Docker 自建，适合个人与团队低成本掌控企业邮箱。
repos.summary_en: Mailflare is a self-hosted professional email inbox for custom domains built on Cloudflare. It leverages Email Routing and Workers for full-featured send/receive with attachments, shared mailboxes, routing rules, real-time notifications and more. Data stays in your own D1 and R2. One-click deploy or Docker self-host, ideal for individuals and teams seeking low-cost control of business email.

repos.description: 既然来了，就留下你的Star吧！Serv00 | CT8 | Hostuno | VPS | 游戏机 | sing-box(reality + hy2 + vmess-argo +tuic5)四合一无交互一键安装脚本(已适配Alpine)，支持纯V6 vps，丰富的分流服务, 可添加anytls,socks5,ss-2022等协议
repos.summary_zh: sing-box多协议代理一键安装脚本，支持VLESS-reality、VMess-ws-tls(Argo)、Hysteria2、Tuic5等协议，适配VPS、Serv00、CT8、Alpine等环境。集成哪吒探针、Argo隧道与订阅管理，提供无交互部署、端口自定义与分流服务，适合快速搭建代理节点与网络加速场景。
repos.summary_en: One-click installation script for sing-box multi-protocol proxy, supporting VLESS-reality, VMess-ws-tls (Argo), Hysteria2, Tuic5. Compatible with VPS, Serv00, CT8, Alpine and more. Integrates Nezha monitoring, Argo tunnels and subscription features for automated deployment, custom ports and traffic routing in proxy and acceleration use cases.

repos.description: AI You Control: Choose your models. Own your data. Eliminate vendor lock-in.
repos.summary_zh: Thunderbolt 是 Mozilla 开源的跨平台 AI 客户端，主打'AI You Control'理念。支持本地部署，兼容 Ollama、llama.cpp 等本地推理引擎及 OpenAI 兼容 API，彻底摆脱供应商锁定。提供桌面、移动端全覆盖，面向企业客户，支持私有化部署，强调数据主权与安全可控，目前处于安全审计阶段，即将企业就绪。
repos.summary_en: Thunderbolt is Mozilla's open-source, cross-platform AI client championing 'AI You Control' with full vendor lock-in elimination. It supports local deployment, integrates with Ollama, llama.cpp and OpenAI-compatible APIs, ensuring data ownership. Available across desktop and mobile platforms, it targets enterprise on-premise deployment with enhanced security and privacy, currently undergoing security audit for production readiness.

repos.description: 自建 Docker 镜像加速与管理服务。零磁盘缓存、可视化面板、支持上游账号认证，支持一键部署Docker、K8s、Quay、Ghcr、Mcr、elastic、nvcr等镜像加速
repos.summary_zh: 该项目提供一键部署的Docker镜像加速服务，基于官方Registry支持Docker Hub、K8s、Quay等主流仓库代理。支持自动配置反向代理（Nginx/Caddy）、缓存控制、IP黑白名单及私有镜像拉取，解决国内镜像下载慢和频率限制问题。可部署在自有服务器或ClawCloud/Render等免费平台，附带Web管理面板实现镜像搜索与容器监控。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a one-click deployable Docker image acceleration service based on the official Registry, supporting proxies for Docker Hub, K8s, Quay, and other major registries. It features automatic reverse proxy (Nginx/Caddy) setup, cache control, IP whitelisting/blacklisting, and private image pulling to address slow downloads and rate limits in China. It can be deployed on private servers or free platforms like ClawCloud/Render, with a web management panel for image search and container monitoring.

repos.description: Bitwarden-compatible server running on Cloudflare Workers
repos.summary_zh: NodeWarden 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的第三方 Bitwarden 兼容服务端，实现零成本自托管密码管理。支持多用户、附件存储、TOTP 及 Passkey 等核心功能，兼容全平台官方客户端。利用 R2/KV 存储保障数据安全，适合个人及小团队私有化部署，规避企业版订阅费用。
repos.summary_en: NodeWarden is a third-party Bitwarden-compatible server deployed on Cloudflare Workers, enabling zero-cost self-hosted password management. It supports multi-user access, attachments, TOTP, and Passkey features while maintaining full compatibility with official clients across platforms. Leveraging R2/KV storage for data security, it's ideal for individuals and small teams seeking private deployment without enterprise subscription fees.

repos.description: Virtual DSM in a Docker container.
repos.summary_zh: vdsm/virtual-dsm 是一个创新的轻量级 NAS 解决方案，通过在 Docker 容器中虚拟化运行 Synology DSM 系统，结合 KVM 硬件加速技术实现接近原生的性能表现。项目支持多磁盘管理、物理设备直通、CPU 与内存灵活配置，可快速部署于 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 平台，适用于个人私有云存储、开发测试环境及轻量级生产场景。
repos.summary_en: vdsm/virtual-dsm is an innovative lightweight NAS solution that virtualizes Synology DSM within Docker containers, leveraging KVM hardware acceleration to deliver near-native performance. This project provides comprehensive storage virtualization capabilities including multi-disk management, raw device passthrough, and dynamic resource allocation for CPU and memory. With support for Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and GitHub Codespaces, it enables rapid deployment across Linux, Windows, and macOS platforms. The solution is particularly suited for personal cloud storage, development testing environments, and scenarios requiring flexible, containerized NAS infrastructure with enterprise-grade features.

repos.description: Something about tools
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个自动化系统重装工具集，核心为InstallNET.sh脚本，支持命令行一键网络重装Debian、Ubuntu、CentOS、AlmaLinux、RockyLinux、Kali、Alpine及Windows 11系统。适用于VPS和物理服务器快速部署，仅需wget即可运行，自动处理各发行版依赖差异。提供默认SSH/RDP配置，特别适合资源受限环境（Alpine仅需256MB内存），是运维人员批量管理和恢复系统的利器。
repos.summary_en: This is an automated system reinstallation toolkit centered around the InstallNET.sh script. It enables one-command network-based reinstallation of Debian, Ubuntu, CentOS, AlmaLinux, RockyLinux, Kali, Alpine Linux, and Windows 11 via command line. Designed for rapid VPS and bare-metal server deployment, it runs with minimal dependencies (wget only) and automatically handles distribution-specific package management differences. Provides default SSH/RDP configurations and is optimized for resource-constrained environments (Alpine requires just 256MB RAM), making it ideal for sysadmins managing batch operations and system recovery.

repos.description: The RethinkDNS resolver that deploys to Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Fastly, and Fly.io
repos.summary_zh: Serverless-dns 是一个自托管的无服务器 DNS 解析器，提供类似 Pi-Hole 的内容过滤功能，支持 DNS-over-HTTPS 和 DNS-over-TLS。它可一键部署到 Cloudflare Workers、Deno Deploy、Fastly 和 Fly.io 等边缘平台，利用其免费层即可满足10-20台设备的日常需求。服务器处理延迟仅0-2毫秒，端到端延迟中位数为10-30毫秒，具备全球覆盖能力。
repos.summary_en: Serverless-dns is a self-hosted, serverless DNS resolver with Pi-Hole-like content blocking, supporting DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) and DNS-over-TLS (DoT). It deploys effortlessly to edge platforms including Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Fastly, and Fly.io. The free tiers suffice for 10-20 devices monthly. Server processing takes 0-2ms, with end-to-end latency of 10-30ms (median), enabling global low-latency DNS resolution.

repos.description: An index & manager of Onedrive based on serverless. Can be deployed to Vercel/Heroku/SCF/FG/FC/CFC/PHP web hosting/VPS.
repos.summary_zh: 一个基于Serverless架构的Onedrive文件管理器，支持Vercel、Heroku及国内云函数平台部署。通过生成直链实现用户直传直下载，大幅节省服务器带宽成本。提供可视化文件管理界面，支持多用户、多目录，适用于个人云盘分享、团队文档协作及静态资源托管场景。
repos.summary_en: A serverless-based OneDrive index and manager that enables seamless deployment across Vercel, Heroku, and major Chinese cloud function platforms including Tencent SCF, Huawei FG, Alibaba FC, and Baidu CFC. The system generates direct URLs allowing end-users to upload and download files directly through Microsoft's infrastructure, minimizing server bandwidth consumption to near zero. With an intuitive web interface supporting multi-user access and directory management, it transforms OneDrive into a fully functional cloud storage portal suitable for personal file sharing, team collaboration, and static website hosting. Its PHP implementation ensures broad compatibility with various hosting environments while maintaining low operational costs.

repos.description: Deploy Your Frontend in a Single Command. Claude Code Skills supported.
repos.summary_zh: PinMe 是一款零配置的前端静态部署工具，通过单命令将构建产物上传至去中心化网络。无需服务器管理，自动处理可用性与持久性，提供可验证内容防止篡改。深度集成 AI 工作流，支持 Claude Code 等直接部署，兼容 React/Vue/Next.js 等主流框架，为开发者与 AI 代理提供极简发布体验。
repos.summary_en: PinMe is a zero-config static frontend deployment tool that publishes sites to decentralized networks with a single command. It eliminates server management, automatically handling availability and persistence while providing verifiable content to prevent tampering. With deep AI workflow integration supporting Claude Code, it offers a frictionless publishing experience for developers and AI agents, compatible with React/Vue/Next.js frameworks.

repos.description: ✦ Gemini ➜ OpenAI API proxy. Serverless!
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个OpenAI API格式的代理，将请求转发至Google Gemini API。利用Gemini免费层的慷慨额度，让仅支持OpenAI接口的开发者工具无缝切换至Gemini模型。支持Vercel、Netlify、Cloudflare Workers等Serverless平台一键部署，无需服务器维护，同时提供Node、Deno、Bun本地运行方案，突破地域限制。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a serverless proxy that translates OpenAI API requests to Google Gemini API format. By leveraging Gemini's generous free tier, it enables developers to use OpenAI-exclusive tools with Gemini models at zero cost. Supports one-click deployment to Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, and Deno Deploy without server maintenance. Offers local development via Node, Deno, or Bun, allowing users outside supported regions to obtain API keys via VPN and access Gemini's powerful models seamlessly.

repos.description: A calm, open system for organizing life and work. Tasks, projects, notes, areas, and smart workflows - self-hosted or hosted.
repos.summary_zh: tududi是一款自托管任务管理工具，融合个人简洁性与专业项目组织能力。核心亮点包括智能递归任务系统（支持多种模式、完成触发机制）、Telegram集成、多层级结构（领域-项目-任务-子任务），以及24种语言支持。面向注重隐私与效率的个人及团队，提供开放API与响应式设计，实现数据自主可控的生产力提升。
repos.summary_en: tududi is a self-hosted task management tool that merges personal simplicity with professional project organization. Its core features include an intelligent recurring task system with multiple patterns and completion-based triggers, seamless Telegram integration, and a hierarchical structure (Areas > Projects > Tasks > Subtasks). Designed for privacy-conscious individuals and teams, it offers 24-language support, OpenAPI documentation, and responsive design for full data control and productivity across devices.

repos.summary_zh: RKNN-Toolkit2是Rockchip NPU的完整AI部署工具链，支持模型转换、推理与性能评估。提供C/Python API，覆盖RK3588/RV1106等多款芯片，具备自动混合精度与图优化能力，助力边缘AI应用快速落地。包含Toolkit、Runtime及Lite版本，支持Python 3.6-3.12，是嵌入式AI开发的核心基础设施，不兼容旧版RKNN-Toolkit。
repos.summary_en: RKNN-Toolkit2 is a complete AI deployment toolchain for Rockchip NPU platforms, enabling model conversion, inference and performance evaluation. It provides both C and Python APIs, supporting multiple chips including RK3588 and RV1106 series. Key features include automatic mixed precision, enhanced graph optimization, and compatibility with Python 3.6-3.12. The toolkit accelerates edge AI application development on embedded devices and is not compatible with the legacy RKNN-Toolkit, requiring migration for new projects.

repos.description: 提升部署在cloudflare、vercel或netlify的网页在中国的访问速度和稳定性   cf优选域名 | cf优选ip | cloudflare | vercel | netlify | 加速 | 国内 | 中国 | 境内 | 大陆
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过自定义CNAME解析，优化Cloudflare、Vercel和Netlify服务在中国大陆的访问体验。核心机制是定时测试各平台IP的速度与稳定性，优选出最佳节点并配置三网解析，将国内流量引导至最优线路，海外使用官方IP。相比官方Anycast常将流量路由至东南亚导致拥堵，此方案能有效改善晚高峰时段的访问速度和连通性稳定性，仅需修改DNS记录即可实现，特别适合部署在海外FaaS平台的中文网站加速。
repos.summary_en: This project enhances access speed and stability for websites hosted on Cloudflare, Vercel, or Netlify in mainland China through custom CNAME redirection. It automatically tests IPs from these platforms every 40 minutes, selecting optimal nodes for China's three major ISPs while using official IPs overseas. By bypassing problematic anycast routing that often directs Chinese traffic to Southeast Asia, it significantly improves connectivity during peak hours and prevents single-point failures. The solution requires only DNS configuration changes, making it ideal for accelerating Chinese access to overseas serverless deployments.

repos.description: Open source AI terminal for cloud and infrastructure management, enabling you to deploy, troubleshoot, and automate services using natural language and intelligent agents.
repos.summary_zh: Chaterm是一款AI原生的智能终端代理，旨在成为DevOps副驾驶。它通过自然语言交互重塑传统命令行体验，内置专家知识库和自主Agent引擎，可自动分解复杂任务并执行从日志分析到服务回滚的全链路操作。支持EC2、数据库和Kubernetes管理，提供智能上下文补全和移动端语音交互能力，消除技术栈认知壁垒，让开发者具备资深SRE的运维能力。
repos.summary_en: Chaterm is an AI-native intelligent terminal agent designed as a DevOps co-pilot. It revolutionizes the command-line experience through natural language interaction, featuring a built-in expert knowledge base and autonomous agent engine capable of planning and executing complex workflows from log analysis to service rollback. It manages EC2 instances, databases, and Kubernetes clusters while offering intelligent contextual completion and real-time voice interaction on mobile devices, empowering developers with SRE-level operational capabilities.

repos.description: Enhances Tesseract OCR output using LLMs (local or API) for error correction, smart chunking, and markdown formatting of scanned PDFs
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过LLM增强传统OCR流程，显著提升扫描PDF的识别准确率与可读性。核心采用Tesseract进行基础OCR识别，再利用本地或API大模型进行智能纠错、分块与Markdown格式化。支持异步处理与GPU加速，适用于文档数字化、档案管理等场景，有效解决OCR常见错误与格式混乱问题。
repos.summary_en: This project enhances traditional OCR pipelines using LLMs to significantly improve accuracy and readability of scanned PDFs. It employs Tesseract for base OCR, then leverages local or API-based LLMs for intelligent error correction, smart chunking, and Markdown formatting. Key features include asynchronous processing, GPU acceleration for local inference, and flexible hybrid deployment. Designed for document digitization, archival management, and office automation, it effectively resolves common OCR errors, duplicate content, and formatting inconsistencies while preserving document structure.

repos.description: Your Self-Hosted Knowledge Base
repos.summary_zh: NoteDiscovery 是一款轻量级自托管笔记与知识库应用，强调数据隐私与所有权。采用纯 Markdown 文件存储，支持知识图谱可视化、LaTeX 数学、Mermaid 图表、内置绘图编辑器及插件扩展。通过 MCP 协议实现与 Claude、Cursor 等 AI 助手的深度集成，支持笔记搜索、创建与组织。提供美观响应式界面、可选认证和多语言支持，是 Notion、Obsidian 的免费开源替代方案，适合开发者、知识工作者及隐私敏感用户，Docker 一键部署，无订阅费用与厂商锁定。
repos.summary_en: NoteDiscovery is a lightweight self-hosted note-taking and knowledge base application that empowers users with full control over their data. Notes are stored as plain Markdown files, featuring an elegant web UI with graph visualization, LaTeX/MathJax support, Mermaid diagrams, a drawing editor, and extensive customization via themes and plugins. It stands out with MCP integration for AI tools like Claude and Cursor, enabling direct note search, creation, and organization. Responsive across devices with optional auth and multi-language support, it serves as a free, open-source alternative to Notion or Obsidian for privacy-focused developers and knowledge workers, with effortless Docker deployment and zero subscriptions or lock-in.

repos.description: AI deep-research agent that turns any question into a cited report: plans searches, reads real sources, verifies evidence. Self-hosted, multi-provider, Docker-ready.
repos.summary_zh: 基于深度研究的AI助手，通过迭代搜索与LLM实现自动化信息挖掘。支持DeepSeek R1等主流模型，提供树状可视化研究流程与实时流式反馈。采用浏览器本地化处理确保数据安全，集成Tavily/Firecrawl多源搜索。支持PDF导出与Docker部署，适用于学术研究、市场分析等深度调研场景。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered research assistant that automates deep information gathering through iterative search and LLM reasoning. Features real-time streaming feedback and tree-structured visualization of research processes. Supports DeepSeek R1 and major LLM providers with local browser processing for data privacy. Integrates Tavily and Firecrawl for web search, offers PDF export, Docker deployment, and server mode. Ideal for academic research, market analysis, and competitive intelligence requiring comprehensive, automated investigation with full citation tracking.

repos.description: CORTEX RAG is an enterprise retrieval and knowledge assistant that helps teams find accurate answers from company data with citations, permission-aware retrieval, and fast deployment
repos.summary_zh: Cortex RAG是一款完全本地的超级RAG系统。支持上传PDF/DOCX/TXT等文档，通过Streamlit界面提问，集成上下文检索、RAG-Fusion、GraphRAG、CRAG、神经重排序、HyDE等九大技术，结合BM25+FAISS+NetworkX知识图谱，实现精准检索、相关性验证、实时推理与来源引用。基于Ollama本地大模型，无需API密钥或云服务，配备语义缓存和多轮对话记忆，保障隐私。适用于敏感文档智能分析、离线知识库构建及个人问答场景。
repos.summary_en: Cortex RAG is a fully local, privacy-first super RAG engine. Upload PDFs, DOCX or TXT files via Streamlit and ask questions. It integrates nine advanced techniques—Contextual Retrieval, RAG-Fusion with RRF, GraphRAG on NetworkX, Corrective RAG, Neural Reranking, HyDE, live reasoning streaming, semantic caching, and chat memory—plus hybrid search (BM25 + FAISS). Powered by Ollama local LLMs, it retrieves, cross-checks, reasons, and cites sources entirely on-device. No API keys, cloud uploads, or subscriptions. Ideal for secure document Q&A, offline knowledge bases, and sensitive data analysis.

repos.description: Run OpenClaw on Android with a single command — no proot, no Linux
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过仅安装glibc动态链接器（ld.so）替代传统proot-distro方案，实现OpenClaw在Android/Termux上的一键部署，存储开销从1-2GB降至约200MB，并提供独立APK应用，无需完整Linux发行版即可运行Node.js应用。
repos.summary_en: Runs OpenClaw on Android/Termux using only glibc ld.so, eliminating proot-distro. Cuts storage from 1-2GB to ~200MB with one-command setup and a standalone APK app.

repos.description: Secure MCP runtime for AI agents to operate local machines, servers, and containers with multi-device orchestration.
repos.summary_zh: AgentDock 为 AI 智能体提供安全 MCP 运行时，支持多设备编排与跨平台控制。通过统一 MCP 接口实现文件、命令、Git、浏览器自动化等操作，兼容 ChatGPT、Claude 等客户端。支持多实例连接同一对话协调跨设备工作，具备明确权限边界、任务可恢复性和技能扩展能力，适用于开发部署、运维管理和真实环境自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: AgentDock is a secure MCP runtime empowering AI agents with controlled access to local machines, servers, and containers via multi-device orchestration. It unifies file operations, command execution, Git, browser automation, and extensible Skills into an MCP interface compatible with clients like ChatGPT and Claude. Multiple instances connect to one conversation for cross-device coordination, featuring explicit permissions, recoverable tasks, and structured results. Ideal for development, deployment, and operations beyond coding quotas across platforms.

repos.description: Open-source AI companions, desktop pets, long-term memory & proactive chat. 人机恋开源项目大全。让你的家机能够脱离官端自主存在，拥有记忆和主动性。
repos.summary_zh: 精选面向长期AI伴侣关系的开源软件、基础设施与社区，覆盖客户端、桌宠、主动心跳、长期记忆、情感状态、语音视觉具身与数据主权等模块，强调脱离官端自主运行，助力构建有记忆、主动性与持续性的人机恋体验。
repos.summary_en: Curated open-source list of software, infrastructure and communities for long-term AI companion relationships. Covers clients, desktop pets, proactive messaging, memory systems, emotion state, voice/visual embodiment and data ownership, enabling independent, memory-rich and proactive companions beyond official platforms.

repos.description: 使用Telegram作为存储的文件外链系统，不限制文件大小和格式。
repos.summary_zh: tgState 是一款创新的文件外链系统，深度利用 Telegram 的 Bot API 和 FileID 机制，将 Telegram 频道/群组作为无限容量存储后端。系统支持任意大小格式的文件存储分发，提供 Web 界面和 API 上传接口，可作为图床或私有网盘使用。支持 Docker、Vercel 等多种部署方式，配合 CloudFlare 可实现高效 CDN 加速。
repos.summary_en: tgState is an innovative file hosting system that leverages Telegram's Bot API and FileID mechanism to utilize Telegram channels/groups as unlimited-capacity storage backend. Supporting files of any size and format, it provides both web interface and API for uploads, functioning as image hosting or private cloud storage. Features flexible deployment via Docker, Vercel, or binary, with CloudFlare CDN integration for optimized content delivery.

repos.description: 【零费用】一个让人呼吸顺畅的 Telegram 双向私聊机器人 🤖 / [Zero Cost] A Smooth-Operating Two-Way Private Messaging Telegram Bot 🤖
repos.summary_zh: Open Wegram Bot 是基于 Cloudflare Worker/Vercel 的 Telegram 双向私聊机器人，实现零成本、无服务器、无数据库的消息中转。采用无状态架构，支持 GitHub/Vercel 等多平台一键部署，无需绑定域名即可运行。适用于个人消息代理、轻量级客服等场景，提供稳定可靠的双向通信能力，是 LivegramBot 的免费替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Open Wegram Bot is a Telegram two-way private messaging bot built on Cloudflare Worker/Vercel, enabling zero-cost, serverless, database-free message forwarding. Featuring stateless architecture, it supports one-click deployment via GitHub/Vercel/Deno/Netlify without custom domain binding. Designed for personal message proxy and lightweight customer service, it provides stable bidirectional communication as a free alternative to LivegramBot with multi-bot support and encrypted security tokens for reliable operation.

repos.description: Selfhost web archiving and sharing service.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare 的免费网页归档服务，通过浏览器插件将页面保存为单文件 HTML，利用 Worker+D1+R2 全栈方案实现低成本存储与检索。集成 AI 自动标签分类、文件夹管理与阅读模式，支持移动端适配，提供完整的归档、搜索与分享功能，适合个人知识沉淀。
repos.summary_en: Web Archive is a free, serverless web archiving and sharing service built entirely on Cloudflare's platform. It captures webpages as single-file HTML through a browser extension and stores them using Cloudflare D1 database and R2 storage via Workers. The platform features AI-powered automatic tag classification, folder organization, reading mode, mobile responsiveness, and searchable archives. Leveraging Cloudflare's generous free tier, it provides a cost-effective, scalable solution for personal knowledge management and digital content preservation.

repos.description: 👏 Make learning a lifelong habit. 学无止境
repos.summary_zh: my-geektime 是极客时间VIP课程的音视频私有化部署系统。支持一次缓存永久观看，一键发布课程为在线文档，以及本地音视频下载。基于Docker容器化技术，提供跨平台部署能力，实现学习资源的离线管理与在线访问，适合构建个人终身学习知识库。
repos.summary_en: my-geektime is a self-hosted GeekTime VIP course platform specializing in audio/video resource management. It enables permanent offline viewing through one-time caching, one-click online documentation publishing, and local media downloads. Built with Docker containerization for cross-platform deployment (amd64/arm64), it transforms streaming content into private learning assets. This tool eliminates dependency on official servers, providing lifelong access to purchased courses while maintaining content organization, search capabilities, and seamless playback functionality for individual learners.

repos.description: 🚀 OpenAI-compatible Freebuff proxy with dynamic free-agent tracking, token rotation, and ready-to-use Docker deployment.
repos.summary_zh: Freebuff2API 是一个 OpenAI 兼容代理服务器，将 Freebuff 免费 AI 模型转换为标准 OpenAI API 格式。支持多账号 token 自动轮换提升调用额度，动态模拟官方 SDK 指纹规避检测，并提供 Docker 快速部署。适用于开发者在不更换现有 OpenAI SDK 代码的前提下，零成本调用 Freebuff 的 AI 模型服务。
repos.summary_en: Freebuff2API is an OpenAI-compatible proxy server that transforms Freebuff's free AI models into standard OpenAI API endpoints. It features automatic multi-token rotation for higher throughput, dynamic client fingerprinting to mimic official SDK behavior, and Docker deployment. Enables developers to use Freebuff's AI services with any OpenAI-compatible client without code changes.

repos.description: Grok2API (Cloudflare Workers) one-click deploy with auto D1+KV provisioning
repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastAPI 重构的 Grok AI 代理 API，全面适配最新 Web 调用格式。支持流式/非流式对话、图像生成与深度思考，内置号池并发与自动负载均衡机制。提供 Cloudflare Workers 无服务器部署方案，集成 D1 数据库与 KV 存储。具备可视化后台管理、自动注册、Token 状态智能判定等企业级功能，实现多端部署一致性。
repos.summary_en: FastAPI-based proxy API for Grok AI, fully adapted to the latest web calling format. Supports streaming/non-streaming conversations, image generation/editing, and deep thinking with built-in account pool concurrency and auto load balancing. Offers Cloudflare Workers serverless deployment with D1 database and KV storage integration. Features visual admin panel, auto-registration with Turnstile solver, intelligent token status detection, and consistent behavior across local, Docker, and serverless deployments.

repos.description: Self-hosted SIM/eSIM gateway for VoWiFi calling, SMS, cellular data and isolated regional egress
repos.summary_zh: MDD Sim Gateway 是面向 Debian/Ubuntu/Armbian ARM64 的自托管多 SIM/eSIM 通信网关。它整合蜂窝模块、USB 读卡器、IMS、EAP-AKA、ModemManager 与 sing-box，通过中英文 Web 控制台实现真实 SIM 鉴权（不读取 Ki/OP）、浏览器软电话通话与短信、多模块统一管理及独立国家出口 TUN，UDP 失败时不泄漏。适用于自建 VoWiFi、隔离区域网络出口与运营商线路保号场景。
repos.summary_en: MDD Sim Gateway is a self-hosted multi-SIM/eSIM communication gateway for Debian/Ubuntu/Armbian ARM64. It integrates cellular modules, USB readers, IMS, EAP-AKA, ModemManager and sing-box into a bilingual web console, enabling real SIM authentication (no Ki/OP exposure), browser softphone calls/SMS, multi-module management and isolated country egress TUNs that never leak on UDP failure. Ideal for self-hosted VoWiFi, regional network isolation and carrier line keepalive.

repos.description: A Powerful Serverless Uptime Monitoring & Status Page on Cloudflare's Edge Network
repos.summary_zh: Uptimer是基于Cloudflare边缘网络的无服务器运行时间监控与状态页面系统。支持HTTP/TCP探测、故障事件管理、维护窗口、Webhook通知（Discord/Slack等）及管理后台，零运维部署于Workers+Pages+D1，实现实时状态展示与告警。
repos.summary_en: Uptimer is a serverless uptime monitoring and status page running on Cloudflare's edge network. It offers HTTP/TCP probes, incident management, maintenance windows, webhook alerts (Discord/Slack/etc.), and an admin dashboard, all deployed zero-ops via Workers + Pages + D1 for real-time status and notifications.

repos.description: 一款功能强大的 Nginx 配置文件可视化编辑工具
repos.summary_zh: nginx-flow 是一款基于 React Flow 的 Nginx 配置可视化编辑器，通过拖拽式画布构建 server/location/upstream 节点，实现配置即编程。内置生产级模板库覆盖 SPA、反向代理、负载均衡等场景，集成智能体检引擎可自动检测安全风险与性能问题并提供一键修复，支持实时配置预览与流量模拟，显著提升运维效率与配置准确性。
repos.summary_en: nginx-flow is a visual Nginx config editor built on React Flow, transforming manual configuration into drag-and-drop canvas programming with server/location/upstream nodes. It features production-ready templates for SPA, reverse proxy, load balancing, and smart audit engine that auto-detects security risks and performance issues with one-click fixes. Real-time config preview, traffic simulation, and bilingual support streamline DevOps workflows, reducing errors and accelerating deployment.

repos.description: 万物皆可搭节点 | Everything can be a proxy node
repos.summary_zh: one-node 是一个极简化的网络代理节点部署工具，核心理念是'万物皆可搭节点'。它允许将任意设备快速转换为功能完整的代理服务器，支持多种协议和平台。通过轻量级架构设计，实现一键部署和灵活配置，适用于个人隐私保护、企业内网访问、网络加速等场景，大幅降低代理节点搭建的技术门槛和运维成本。
repos.summary_en: one-node is a minimalist network proxy node deployment tool embodying the philosophy 'Everything can be a proxy node'. It enables rapid conversion of any device into a fully functional proxy server, supporting multiple protocols and platforms. With its lightweight architecture, it offers one-click deployment and flexible configuration for scenarios including personal privacy protection, corporate intranet access, and network acceleration, significantly reducing technical barriers and operational costs.

repos.description: 翼龙面板node.js环境 部署：xHTTP版 Argo双模固定隧道quic/http2、临时隧道；直连hy2、tuic、reality
repos.summary_zh: 翼龙面板Node.js部署环境，支持Argo双模隧道（QUIC/HTTP2）、TUIC、Hysteria2及VLESS-Reality等代理协议。针对64MB低内存平台深度优化，内置6级自适应匹配与主动内存回收机制，兼容多个免费托管平台，适用于网络运维与抗封锁场景。
repos.summary_en: Node.js deployment environment for Yilong Panel supporting Argo dual-mode tunnels (QUIC/HTTP2), TUIC, Hysteria2, and VLESS-Reality proxy protocols. Deeply optimized for 64MB low-memory platforms with 6-level adaptive matching and active memory reclamation, compatible with multiple free hosting services for network operations and anti-blocking.

repos.description: OpenAI-compatible Web Chat API proxy with GPT, Grok, Gemini account management and Docker self-hosting
repos.summary_zh: webchat2api 将 ChatGPT Web、Grok/xAI Web 与 Gemini Web 逆向封装为 OpenAI 兼容及 Gemini 原生 API 代理，支持多账号池管理、文生文/文生图、tier 感知调度与 Docker 一键自托管。提供 FastAPI 后端与 Next.js 管理后台，覆盖账号导入、代理配置、内容过滤、云备份及图片存储，适合个人学习与私有化部署场景。
repos.summary_en: webchat2api wraps ChatGPT Web, Grok/xAI Web and Gemini Web into OpenAI-compatible and Gemini native API proxies, with multi-account pools, text/image generation, tier-aware routing and Docker self-hosting. Features FastAPI backend plus Next.js admin UI for account management, proxies, content filtering, cloud backup and image storage—ideal for personal research and private deployments.

repos.summary_zh: HiDeck 是一款自托管的 Qualcomm 4G/LTE/5G 调制解调器管理控制台，通过浏览器统一管理 USB 蜂窝模块，支持代理绑定、短信收发、WiFi 通话、VoLTE、eSIM 管理及定时任务自动化，采用 Go + Vue 3 构建，Docker 一键部署。
repos.summary_en: HiDeck is a self-hosted web console for managing Qualcomm 4G/LTE/5G cellular modems through a browser interface. It supports USB modem auto-discovery across QMI, MBIM, AT, and PC/SC protocols, SOCKS5/HTTP proxy binding, SMS inbox and sending, WiFi calling, native VoLTE, eSIM provisioning, and scheduled task automation with notifications via Telegram, email, Bark, Feishu, and WeChat. Built with Go and Vue 3, it deploys via Docker with SQLite storage, supporting both binary and containerized installation for Linux systems with multi-language documentation.

repos.description: spoo.me is an open-source & API first link management infra
repos.summary_zh: spoo.me 是一个开源、API 优先的短链接管理服务，提供自定义 slug（含 emoji）、密码保护、点击限制等高级功能。其核心亮点在于强大的分析能力，支持地理位置、设备、流量模式、引荐来源和机器人检测的多维度统计，并提供 CSV/JSON/XLSX/XML 数据导出。无需注册即可使用，支持自托管，完全免费且无功能限制，适合需要私有化部署或集成短链能力的开发者和企业。
repos.summary_en: spoo.me is an open-source, API-first URL shortening infrastructure offering advanced features like custom slugs (including emojis), password protection, and click limits. Its core strength lies in comprehensive analytics covering geographic distribution, device breakdown, traffic patterns, referrer tracking, and bot detection, with multi-format data export (CSV/JSON/XLSX/XML). Requiring no registration, it provides completely free unlimited usage with self-hosting capability. Ideal for developers and enterprises needing private deployment or integrated link management with detailed click insights.

repos.description: Open-source network quality monitoring platform with multi-node Ping, TCPing, HTTP, DNS, IPv6 and Traceroute testing.
repos.summary_zh: 开源多节点网络质量监控平台，支持Ping/TCPing/HTTP/DNS/Traceroute/IPv6探测。采用Master+Agent+RabbitMQ架构，基于RuoYi-Vue-Plus、Next.js与Prometheus Blackbox，提供Agent自动上下线、一键部署、IP地理解析及广告系统，助力企业低成本搭建网络运维与测速平台。
repos.summary_en: Open-source multi-node network quality monitoring platform supporting Ping, TCPing, HTTP, DNS, Traceroute and IPv6. Built with Master+Agent+RabbitMQ architecture using RuoYi-Vue-Plus, Next.js and Prometheus Blackbox. Features auto Agent management, one-click deployment, IP geolocation and ad system for low-cost enterprise network ops.

repos.description: OneDrive public directory listing, and One-Click Deploy to Vercel. Powered by Vercel and Next.js.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Next.js 和 Vercel 的 OneDrive 目录列表程序，支持一键部署。通过将配置迁移至 Vercel 环境变量，省去手动修改配置文件的繁琐步骤，实现快速上线。提供文件预览、下载功能，支持文件夹密码保护，并优化 OAuth 认证流程以增强安全性，适合免费搭建私有文件分享站点。
repos.summary_en: A OneDrive directory listing solution built with Next.js and Vercel, featuring one-click deployment. By migrating configurations to Vercel environment variables, it eliminates manual config file editing, enabling rapid setup. Offers file preview and download capabilities, supports password-protected folders, and enhances OAuth security by auto-closing authentication channels.

repos.description: 极简 Cloudflare Worker，接收私人域名邮件并提供 HTTP API 读取
repos.summary_zh: ni-mail 是一个极简 Cloudflare Worker，通过 Email Routing 接收私人域名邮件并提供 HTTP API 读取。使用 KV 存储最多 50 封邮件，postal-mime 解析为结构化 JSON，支持 API Key 鉴权和多自定义域名，附件仅存 metadata。无需数据库、前端或 JWT，部署简单，适合自动化脚本获取邮件内容，实现轻量级邮件集成。
repos.summary_en: ni-mail is a minimalist Cloudflare Worker that receives private domain emails via Cloudflare Email Routing and exposes them through a simple HTTP API. It stores up to 50 emails in KV, parses them with postal-mime into structured JSON, supports API key auth and multiple custom domains, and keeps only attachment metadata. No database, frontend or JWT needed; ideal for automation scripts fetching emails in a lightweight, serverless setup.

repos.description: onekey script to install xray on alpine system
repos.summary_zh: 专为Alpine Linux设计的Xray-core一键安装脚本，自动从官方GitHub下载最新版本，安装至系统路径，配置基础SOCKS代理，并注册为OpenRC服务实现开机自启。适用于轻量级服务器快速部署代理节点，简化Alpine环境下的Xray运维。
repos.summary_en: One-click shell script to install and configure Xray-core on Alpine Linux. Automatically downloads the latest official release, installs the binary, sets up a basic SOCKS proxy, and registers it as an OpenRC service with auto-start. Ideal for lightweight servers needing quick proxy deployment.

repos.description: 一个基于 Next.js 开发的全栈 Docker 镜像仓库管理私服，支持一键部署到Vercel。解决国内 Pull 镜像困难问题。
repos.summary_zh: Pocker 是基于 Next.js 的全栈 Docker 镜像仓库管理系统，专为解决国内 Docker Hub 拉取缓慢而设计。系统通过 GitHub Actions 自动化将镜像转存至华为云 SWR，支持一键 Vercel 部署、多区域节点切换、镜像/标签/命名空间全生命周期管理，并提供用量统计与暗黑模式。让每个人都能拥有自主可控的 Docker 私服。
repos.summary_en: Pocker is a full-stack Docker registry management system built with Next.js, designed to solve slow Docker Hub pulls in China. It automatically transfers images to Huawei Cloud SWR via GitHub Actions, enabling one-click Vercel deployment. Key features include multi-region node switching (23 global nodes), complete lifecycle management of images/tags/namespaces, usage statistics, dark mode, and automated workflows. It empowers individuals and teams to own private Docker registries with full data control and security.

repos.description: Turn a private Hugging Face repo into your own cloud storage service.
repos.summary_zh: Hugging Cloud 将私有 Hugging Face 仓库转化为自托管云存储服务，专为 AI 团队管理模型与数据集设计。基于 FastAPI+Next.js 全栈架构，提供 RBAC 权限控制、可恢复上传和签名链接安全访问。Docker 容器化部署，支持 SQLite/Postgres 和 Redis，兼顾轻量便捷与生产级扩展能力。
repos.summary_en: Hugging Cloud transforms private Hugging Face repositories into self-hosted cloud storage services, purpose-built for AI teams managing models and datasets. Built on a modern FastAPI+Next.js stack, it delivers enterprise-grade features including RBAC access control, resumable uploads, and cryptographically signed download links. Docker containerized deployment supports both SQLite for lightweight use and Postgres/Redis for production scalability, enabling seamless integration into existing AI infrastructure while maintaining data privacy and access governance.
